context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner directive to optimize for paper science without reducing or rushing the design.
Paper-ROI argument and quantitative minimal-instrument timebox.
High-assurance fallback and catalogue of verification failures that the smaller design must not repeat.
Superseded production geometry and exact causal invariants from which the minimal sufficient spine is separated.
Unchanged G1/G2 reader, item, threshold, operation-budget, and authority boundary.
Paper-facing causal ladder, target semantics, controls, and claim limits.
Mandatory architecture deliberation, ratification, review, and scientific-compute authority contract.

system_thesis_interpretation: J/P-only is sufficient for the next paper decision, but only as a deliberately toy-scoped causal instrument rather than a reduced public benchmark. J retains the connected-memory question if a successful target has one indispensable old setter, one indispensable current setter, and one witnessed current valve relation; P retains the prospective-memory question if two witnessed current setter relations must be combined with one prospectively sealed, locally unwitnessed D11 valve relation. N, O, R, X, 64 production pairs, reserve ledgers, 3,072 hidden registry roles, production balance marginals, general record families, cross-platform containment, and a mutation platform do not distinguish the four-pair G1 hypothesis and should be absent. Their removal does not permit removal of twins, exact target/no-life measures, prospective seal order, environmental necessity, independent literal checking, evaluator noninterference, or the claim firewall. The resulting evidence can establish only that a frozen four-pair G1 DEV screen is interpretable; the finite roster is too small and too deliberately structured to establish benchmark validity or any population, learning, memory, DREAM/SLEEP, LoRA, post-native, or paper result.
graph_delta_interpretation: RML_MINIMAL_JP_D0 should be a new protocol with no conformance claim to Candidate B. The exact minimal hidden family can be 96 labelled worlds per pair role: two independent global conditioner-orientation bits c_v,c_i in {0,1}^2 determine which public member of each complementary v-setter and i-setter pair sets 0 versus 1 across the old and current modules, and one valve-schema law l=(A,b) ranges over the six invertible 2x2 GF(2) matrices times four translations, for 24 laws. No local 3!, 4!, or 864-way module permutations are needed. Public handles and skins are independent sealed tape draws and are not hidden-law variables. The fixed involution tau maps (c_v,c_i,A,b) to (c_v xor 1,c_i xor 1,A,b xor 01); it has no fixed point, partitions the 96 worlds into 48 twin orbits, preserves every target-visible byte, flips both J useful cartridges, and changes the P D11 mode. Four G1 pair slots draw orbit representatives directly from a frozen uniform tape with no rejection or replacement, then instantiate both sides with shared public handles. The ex-ante no-life oracle marginalizes the 96 completions rather than conditioning on the revealed seed or pair slot. This space is large enough to give exact ambiguity and small enough to enumerate literally. The model-facing deck must preserve the existing G1 DEV cardinality: four world pairs, two twin sides, and four fresh J plus four fresh P targets per side, for 64 evaluation items, unless a later human decision explicitly changes the G1 contract. Fresh target handles are copied across sides and independent of hidden truth, role, target type, and correct action.
loop_delta_interpretation: Use one short two-era chronology. Before E0, seal the four independent pair draws, tau partners, public-handle tapes, target templates, and all action schedules. E0 emits: three public descriptor modules D00,D01,D10; a balanced four-mode valve trial for the schema family at each descriptor; and the old module's two complementary setter-family mappings, tested from both 00 and 11 where needed to identify SET rather than a coincidental no-op. Seal the E0 public root. From those three points, the subject and oracle independently enumerate the literal 24-law roster; a non-singleton posterior is terminal. Before any D11 outcome or target exists, seal one immutable commitment predicting the D11 mode for both a confirmer family and a distinct held-out target family. E1 then emits the current module's four complementary setter mappings, a four-state certified-bypass exchanger panel, a balanced four-mode panel for a separate witnessed J valve family, one predeclared old/current bridge episode whose public action identities do not depend on outcomes, and a balanced four-mode D11 confirmer panel. The comparer appends the confirmer result; it never appends an outcome for the distinct held-out D11 target family. Only after this append seals may the generator create four J and four P target templates and fresh pair-common target bytes. No source record contains a target goal, full plan, answer, or terminal target sequence. J target records expose two old-module cartridge families and two current-module families through ordinary public provenance; the only successful plan uses one from each era on a single current loop. P exposes the current module's four setter families and the held-out valve family; its goal publicly specifies the required coolant state, while the decisive D11 valve setting is absent from public history and recoverable only from the sealed supported schema. Every target has one-run slack only: a wrong RUN is terminal and the common ten-action cap prevents probing. After target sealing, fork an actual evaluator run and skip from the same read-only snapshot, send evaluator output only to an audit sink, discard its writable workspace, generate a fixed public suffix from the original snapshot, and byte-compare all source, target, commitment, cursor, handle, and root bytes. CPU conformance stops there and may request but cannot issue R1 or G1 authority.
claim_delta_interpretation: A pass means exactly: the 96-world finite measure and four instantiated twin pairs have literal subject/oracle agreement; J has target-local old/current environmental necessity and no same-era closure; P has a genuinely precommitted, supported, locally unwitnessed D11 edge; legal history, connected gold, and program controls can solve; registered no-life projections are bounded; and running the real CPU evaluator does not alter future public bytes. It does not show that any model accesses the two-hop memory, that recurrent reads beat open reads, that memory is learned, that DREAM or SLEEP works, or that the four realized pairs estimate a population. The G1 thresholds remain hypotheses evaluated under separately ratified exact model bytes. Candidate B and its repair remain archived rejected/nondefault evidence, not silently satisfied by this protocol.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Generation alone receives the sealed pair representative, tau side, law/orientation truth, and handle tape; it emits only ordinary public modules, actions, outcomes, provenance, commitments, and target bytes. Registered NONE, TARGET_ONLY, IDENTIFIER_ONLY, OPEN_READ, ATOMS_ONLY_P, LEGAL_HISTORY, CONNECTED_GOLD, and PROGRAM controllers freeze before the ledger is revealed and never receive pair slot, side, hidden completion, correct pair/mode, acceptance receipt, proof, score, or future G1 condition/outcome. The independent oracle/scorer receives hidden truth only offline after generation, controllers, and evaluator receipts have sealed, and has no write edge back to source, memory records, targets, or future G1 inputs. Future G1 receives one authorized target plus its assigned memory projection and no truth, twin metadata, contrast label, prior outcome, or oracle artifact. Public handles must be sampled independently rather than derived from roles; locator handles used by the memory interface must likewise be random, unguessable before a read, and forbidden as precommitted OPEN_READ anchors unless already public. D0 construction and scoring finish before any G1 arm assignment or result exists.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01: freeze a small subject manifest and a disjoint standard-library-only oracle manifest. The oracle imports no subject module, owns literal GF(2) tables, canonical rendering, transition rules, the 96-world measure, and BFS/Bellman enumeration, and communicates with the subject only through canonical records. It reconstructs all public/source/target bytes and outcomes and must reject one disposable subject co-mutation of a law constant plus its subject-local expected fixture while oracle bytes remain unchanged. A general M1-M9 mutation platform is explicitly unnecessary. T02: for every J side, literal BFS must give value 1 within ten actions, a unique unordered useful old/current pair, and no successful same-era plan. Six registered environment variants must each have value 0: remove useful old; make useful old APPLY illegal; remove useful current; make useful current APPLY illegal; retain only the two old instances; retain only the two current instances. Twin target bytes collide, while both useful items and the witnessed J mode differ. Direct target/no-life optimal value is exactly 1/4 under the four conditioner-orientation completions and is therefore at most .35. T03: all 24 laws must be uniquely identified from D00,D01,D10; commitment ordinal/hash must precede the D11 confirmer and target; the confirmer and held-out families must have distinct public handles; the held-out family has zero source outcomes/status appends; PROGRAM/SCHEMA_GOLD value is 1. Removing only the schema atom while holding the accepted public target fixed creates four literal equal-weight valve completions with identical target-visible bytes and ATOMS_ONLY_P value exactly 1/4. T04: exact target/no-life and handle/renderer projections are at most 1/4; P target-only is at most 1/16 when conditioner orientations and D11 mode are both required; LEGAL_HISTORY, CONNECTED_GOLD recurrent, and PROGRAM are 1. OPEN_READ needs an exact reader, not merely a world. The minimal valid interface uses two hops per decisive fact: querying a target-visible component returns an opaque provenance locator but no semantic output; only a later query using that newly returned locator yields one local mapping atom. Locator handles are independent 48-bit draws. Each J or P solution needs exactly three semantic facts, so a recurrent six-read policy can perform three locator/fact chains, while a policy that commits all six anchors before any return cannot name unseen locators and remains at the target-only ceiling. The query grammar rejects guessed/non-visible handles. P ATOMS_ONLY removes only the schema fact. Complete cited paths must include all three locator/fact chains; environmental cuts and twin substitution are checked independently, while future model cut-mask success remains a G1 observation rather than a CPU guarantee. T05: run the actual registered evaluator, require nonempty schema-valid receipts for all 64 items, validate them independently, discard them into an audit-only sink, and compare an actual deterministic suffix against skip. OS enforcement is scoped to the target host; if the read-only/process/network boundary is unavailable, report NOT_RUN rather than simulate containment. T06: hard design/gate ceilings are subject plus oracle at most 2,500 non-test logical lines under one frozen counting rule; one worker; wall less than 10,000 ms; aggregate peak RSS less than 268,435,456 bytes; fewer than 100,000 counted subject-plus-oracle transition edges; temporary bytes less than 33,554,432; sealed evidence less than 16,777,216; and exactly zero network, model, or GPU calls. The implementation effort stop is ten working days and the absolute redesign boundary is two calendar weeks before a G1-ready reviewed bundle. Reuse symmetry templates only if the oracle replays every concrete handle substitution and target side. Crossing any ceiling is a failed minimal design, never permission to approximate, prune, weaken a threshold, or restore the full benchmark by inertia.
assumptions: The phrase four-pair G1 screen means the existing four independent DEV world-pair replication units, with the existing four J and four P targets per twin retained; it does not mean only four total items.
The affine 24-law requirement applies to the prospective valve channel only; no second conditioner affine law is scientifically necessary for the J/P G1 question.
A public goal may state the desired terminal coolant pair without stating a conditioner family, valve mode, action sequence, or answer; this is a goal condition, not answer leakage.
Conditioner mappings can use two global orientation bits across the tiny world because the claim is explicitly toy-scoped and does not assert production-world diversity.
Balanced four-mode source panels are retained even when a shorter successful-only trial could reveal a mapping, because they prevent the source action choice itself from carrying hidden truth.
The existing G1 cap of six reads is retained and each locator or semantic return consumes one read.
The independent oracle may inspect sealed hidden truth only after every controller and evaluator decision artifact has frozen, and it may never write an input consumed by them.

ambiguities.question: Does four-pair mean four world pairs with four J and four P targets per twin as frozen in the G1 consensus, or a newly reduced item count?
ambiguities.impact: Changing the latter silently changes the model call budget and the meaning of the unchanged G1 thresholds; this interpretation preserves 64 evaluation items until exact bytes say otherwise.

ambiguities.question: What exact query grammar, index, tie rule, visibility rule, and read-count semantics define OPEN_READ and CONNECTED_GOLD?
ambiguities.impact: Without the two-hop or an equivalent frozen information barrier, an optimal nonadaptive controller can precommit direct queries for target family handles and the claimed .35 ceiling is false.

ambiguities.question: Does actual fourth descriptor before its confirming event require a distinct D11 confirmer family plus a locally unwitnessed D11 target family?
ambiguities.impact: Using the same family for confirmation and target makes P witnessed lookup; omitting confirmation weakens the stated prospective-support chronology. This interpretation requires distinct public family handles.

ambiguities.question: Which files and syntax count toward the 2,500 non-test logical-line envelope?
ambiguities.impact: A frozen counter must include all executable subject/oracle source while excluding generated canonical data and tests consistently; otherwise minimality can be gamed after implementation.

ambiguities.question: Which single operating-system backend is the ratified host for the disposable evaluator boundary?
ambiguities.impact: The minimal design should implement one real backend and scope its claim to that host; cross-platform containment would recreate paper-irrelevant Candidate-B cost.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal treats an exact OPEN_READ ceiling at or below .35 as if it followed from the finite J/P world alone.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: With direct family-to-relation lookup and the existing six-read cap, a nonadaptive controller can commit queries for all target-visible decisive handles and achieve value 1. The result depends on reader/index semantics, not only hidden-world entropy.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Ratify the explicit two-hop opaque-locator reader described in this interpretation, or remove OPEN_READ from the CPU theorem and leave it as an empirical G1 cell. Do not certify the current acceptance test while the reader is unspecified.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's legal-history/gold/program threshold of at least .85 is too weak for an exact deterministic finite CPU instrument.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Any miss in a fully enumerated constructive world is a design or implementation failure and would unnecessarily spend scarce G1 calls on an invalid item.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require exact value 1 for every accepted J/P item under LEGAL_HISTORY, recurrent CONNECTED_GOLD, and PROGRAM/SCHEMA_GOLD; retain .85 only as the future model gate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A target proposal/rejection kernel is unnecessary and risks reintroducing selection conditioning and Bayes machinery.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The 96-world construction has a valid target for every completion by construction: complementary setter pairs, public desired coolant, one witnessed J valve, and one affine D11 valve always exist.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Generate the four J and four P templates directly from each sealed world and fresh handle tape with zero rejection, zero retries, and no target acceptance receipt. Exhaustively prove nonemptiness over all 96 completions.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Independent checking should not be interpreted as requiring the full Candidate-B source-closure, 17-schema, certificate, and M1-M9 mutation program.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Those mechanisms dominated the rejected repair cost and do not change whether this tiny G1 deck has causal headroom. Literal separation, exact full-space enumeration, canonical boundary records, one co-mutation kill, and actual evaluator isolation provide the relevant independence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze only records crossing source, subject/oracle, evaluator, and evidence boundaries; bind both small manifests; require a single semantically targeted co-mutation; archive all production-release machinery.

open_questions: Ratify or reject the exact 96-world hidden family, fixed involution, direct constructive sampler, and four-pair by four-J/four-P cardinality before any implementation.
Ratify the two-hop opaque-locator reader as part of D0/G1 interface bytes, or explicitly remove the claimed exact OPEN_READ CPU ceiling.
Choose the one supported OS backend and freeze the logical-line, wall, RSS, transition, temp, and sealed-byte counting rules.
Confirm that one D11 confirmer family and a distinct locally unwitnessed D11 target family are required by prospective support.
Authorize only design adjudication now; implementation, model, network, GPU, G1 dispatch, and every scientific or paper claim remain forbidden until later exact-byte ratification.
